text.en:
Section sixteen hundred and seventy-three of the Administrative Code of nineteen hundred and
seventeen, as amended by Act Numbered Thirty-five hundred and eighty, is hereby further amended to read as
"Section 1673. Office of provincial fiscal.-Except as otherwise provided there shall be a provincial fiscal for
each province. To be eligible for appointment to this position a person shall be a citizen of the United States or
of the Philippine Islands who has been duly admitted to practise in the courts of said Islands, and has been in
actual practice for at least four years prior to his appointment, or has held during a like period, within the
Philippine Islands or within the United States, the office of clerk of court, law clerk in a Bureau of the Insular
Government, or an office requiring the services of a lawyer. He must be able to speak and write the Spanish
language or the English language and, being conversant with one, he shall have at least a fair knowledge of
the other. No person shall hold the office of city fiscal, or assistant city fiscal of Manila, provincial fiscal, or
deputy fiscal after he attains the age of sixty years; and after the thirty-first day of December, nineteen
hundred and thirty, any city fiscal or assistant city fiscal of Manila, provincial fiscal, or deputy fiscal over
sixty years of age shall vacate his office.
"The salary of the provincial fiscal and all other expenses incident to the maintenance of his office shall be
paid by the province or provinces to which the service rendered pertains.
"Clerks, interpreters, and other subordinates in the office of the provincial fiscal shall be appointed and their
salaries fixed in the same manner as in the case of employees in other provincial offices."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 26, 1930.
